dispatcher: Albert Hazan (session request to resolve issue #2788)
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write.
Do not change preview gate proof, dependency or evidence bundle semantics for issues that do have a db-work-scope block.
assumptions: parseQueueScope returns null only when the issue body has no db-work-scope fence.
The change requires no database object or migration-author route.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would require changing parseQueueScope itself.
Stop if completion requires any file outside the lane script, its test and the evidence pair.
